LESSON: GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.1: Good Citizenship in School
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Good Citizenship in School, part of Citizenship and Governance in Kenya in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we demonstrate good citizenship in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm qualities of a good citizen in school,

2. use digital or print resources to identify qualities of a good citizen in school,

3. role-play qualities of a good citizen in a school,

4. engage a role model in the community and discuss good citizenship,

5. design a poster with qualities of a good citizen in school,

6. write an essay on qualities of a good citizen and share in class.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm qualities of a good citizen in school,
2. use digital or print resources to identify qualities of a good citizen in school,
3. role-play qualities of a good citizen in a school,
4. engage a role model in the community and discuss good citizenship,
5. design a poster with qualities of a good citizen in school,
6. write an essay on qualities of a good citizen and share in class.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Good Citizenship in School together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: Learners role-play qualities of a good citizen in school

Values:
Unity: Learners design a poster with qualities of a good citizen in school

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: Learners develop harmonious coexistence as they discuss how to become a good citizen in school

Links to other Learning Areas:
English: Learners apply writing skills as they write an essay on a good digital citizen (using technology in a positive way)

and share the essays in class.
